package.name: ps_interfaces
package.description:
Messages and actions for the macro-ps photometric-stereo inspection camera head: focus-lens control, lens homing, and LED ring illumination.
This package is built twice from the same definitions: by colcon inside the container for the host-side nodes, and cross-compiled into the RP2040's libmicroros.a by install.sh (see firmware/macro-ps/micro_ros/README.md). Anything added here therefore costs a micro-ROS library rebuild.
